strings.en:
{10}, is it... Been wonderin' about
somethin' for a while now. A long time
back, you said that before ya came here,
you'd never once tended a spear,{1a}right?{1a}But watchin' you, I can't buy that. Every
spear ya got is well kept. ... Training to
overcome the weakness in my heart was
everything to me. The spear was only a{1a}tool for that. So it ain't a weapon for
killin' people, and ya never needed to
sharpen the blade, that it? A plain staff
would have served. So I had no need of{1a}a blade. It is different now... Well, sure,
now ya gotta fight monsters. No... I have
only lately come to see.{1a}Even this instrument for killing people
can, depending on how it is used, become
a tool to protect them... ...How d'ya say
somethin' that slick with a straight{1a}face? Forgive me... I'm complimentin' ya.
That's just like you, I mean. Looks good
on ya, Felcad. Understood. ... Go carefully.
strings.tl: [HERO], is it... Been wonderin' about somethin' for a while now. A long time back, you said that before ya came here, you'd never once tended a spear, right? // But watchin' you, I can't buy that. Every spear ya got is well kept. ... Training to overcome the weakness in my heart was everything to me. The spear was only a tool for that. So it ain't a weapon for killin' people, and ya never needed to sharpen the blade, that it? A plain staff would have served. So I had no need of a blade. It is different now... Well, sure, now ya gotta fight monsters. No... I have only lately come to see. // Even this instrument for killing people can, depending on how it is used, become a tool to protect them... ...How d'ya say somethin' that slick with a straight face? Forgive me... I'm complimentin' ya. That's just like you, I mean. Looks good on ya, Felcad. Understood. ... Go carefully.
